name: Nib
author: Notible
description: A small helper in the corner. Ask how Notible works; answers come only from the Help and plugins in your version, offline.
guide:
Nib is a little pixel-art fella in the bottom-left corner of your notes. Click it and ask how to do something, in plain words: "how do I link notes", "restore a deleted note", "keyboard shortcuts".

## What it knows

Only what your copy of Notible has: its Help pages and the guides of plugins that are turned on. If a feature belongs to a built-in plugin that is off, Nib says so and offers **Turn on**, which opens that plugin in Settings, where you flip the switch yourself. If it has nothing, it says it doesn't know yet. Answers from a community plugin's guide are labelled as such, with the plugin's id.

## Waking it

- Click him.
- Press **Ctrl+Shift+H** when you are not typing in a note (change it in Settings → Hotkeys).
- Escape closes it and puts you back where you were.

## Privacy

Nib works offline. Questions are not saved or sent anywhere; it forgets them when Notible closes.

## Choosing the corner helper

Only one plugin sits in the corner. Pick Nib, another helper or None in **Settings → Plugins → Corner helper**.
